newsitem.title: USA: ITT Corp bidding for Italy's SEAT SpA -WSJ.
newsitem.headline: ITT Corp bidding for Italy's SEAT SpA -WSJ.

text.p: ITT Corp is bidding to buy SEAT SpA, an Italian publisher of telephone directories valued at $1.6 billion, the Wall Street Journal said in its electronic edition Friday.
The report said ITT, which is selling assets in an attempt to fight a hostile takeover by Hilton Hotels, is one of five bidders for the company, which is being privatized by the Italian government.

ITT had bid on SEAT last fall. An ITT spokesman told the paper the company is a "jewel." He said ITT plans to include SEAT in its World Directories unit even though ITT plans to sell the unit, because including SEAT "makes World Directories a stronger company and presumably worth more."
